newsitem.title: USA: Network General sees Q1 shr $0.14 - $0.16.
newsitem.headline: Network General sees Q1 shr $0.14 - $0.16.

text.p: Network General Corp Tuesday said it expects earnings for its fiscal first quarter, ending June 30, to range between $0.14 and $0.16 per share, a drop from $0.19 per share reported in the year ago quarter.
The computer networking products maker said it expects quarterly revenues between $57.5 and $58.5 million versus $51.7 million generated last year.
Analysts had expected the company to earn between $0.14 and $0.19 a share, according to First Call.
Sales were primarily affected by order weakness in Europe that is expected to continue through calendar year 1997.
Network General also said longer sales cycles for its products are expected through the remainder of calendar 1997.
Network General expects to release final results for the first fiscal quarter on July 23.
Analysts' mean estimate for the quarter is $0.18 a share, based on forecasts from five analysts, according to First Call.
